PublicPolicySection.title: A public policy instrument
PublicPolicySection.text: SEDES puts into practice the integrated information system established by Law No. 13,153/2015, bringing together data on droughts, loss of vegetation cover, land degradation and desertification. Under the National Policy to Combat Desertification and Mitigate the Effects of Drought, it supports living with drought, reducing vulnerabilities and preventing land degradation, expanding society's access to knowledge about the territory.
